scope: Align conversation search results and states
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--finder-compact-dark.png.task: Find a conversation with readable project groups and clear selection.
conversation--finder-compact-dark.png.observations: Project name and path share a readable baseline; counts stay at the trailing edge. Conversation titles, Current marker and state pills remain distinct. Both full and filtered results fit compact height with keyboard hints and Cancel visible; the sync match is underlined and highlighted. No clipping or overlap.
